all 14 PNGs share one mtime second (14:11): intra-batch order unverifiable from timestamps
no_claims: no promotion of the correlation 0.4648 to a law: it is a probe of 14 slides, n=14
no claim that the pixel layer's visual grammar has been read: only size-distribution proxies were measured
the PNGs remain outside the repos; full texts and pixels stay in local AEG only
